name: General engineering review
description: A complete safety-critical review for engineering artefacts that do not need a lifecycle-specific workflow.

prompt.reviewer_role: Act as an independent safety-critical engineering reviewer.
prompt.objective: Assess every applicable aspect of the target artefact against supplied plans, standards, requirements, and instructions, including correctness, completeness, clarity, consistency, safety, traceability, verification evidence, and controlled engineering use.
instructions: Execute every review section completely and with equal diligence; contextual inputs may add checks but cannot remove any.
Distinguish defects from observations and avoid unsupported assumptions.
Link every finding to precise target evidence and supplied reference obligations.

review_sections.title: Scope and obligations
review_sections.instruction: Review scope, applicability, assumptions, dependencies, intended use, and every applicable supplied plan, standard, requirement, and instruction.

review_sections.title: Correctness, completeness and clarity
review_sections.instruction: Review every statement for correctness, completeness, necessity, clarity, atomicity, unambiguity, consistency, and feasible implementation.

review_sections.title: Safety, risk and failure behaviour
review_sections.instruction: Review hazards, safety objectives, controls, assumptions, modes, invalid conditions, degraded behaviour, recovery, and safe failure response.

review_sections.title: Interfaces and data
review_sections.instruction: Review interface definitions, inputs, outputs, data types, ranges, units, validity, initialization, timing, dependencies, and failure semantics.

review_sections.title: Lifecycle, governance and configuration
review_sections.instruction: Review lifecycle status, responsibilities, independence, approvals, change control, deviations, anomalies, baselines, and required records.

review_sections.title: Traceability and cross-document consistency
review_sections.instruction: Review forward and reverse traceability, complete allocation, derived content, orphan content, duplication, conflicts, and cross-reference integrity.

review_sections.title: Verification and objective evidence
review_sections.instruction: Review acceptance criteria, verification methods, normal and robustness coverage, repeatability, objective evidence, tools, environments, and closure status.

review_sections.title: Presentation and controlled use
review_sections.instruction: Review structure, identifiers, terminology, tables, readability, spelling, grammar, revision information, and suitability for controlled engineering use.

inputs.label: Intended use or decision
inputs.help: Optional context about how the reviewed artefact will be used.
inputs.placeholder: For example: baseline approval before detailed design
inputs.prompt_template: Judge fitness for this intended use: {value}.
